description: This file implements the XINGSeeker class, which provides functionality to parse XING headers in MP3 files for seeking purposes, including extracting duration, offset for a given time, and encoder delay/padding information.

classes.name: XINGSeeker
classes.description: A class for parsing and seeking within MP3 files using XING headers.

methods.name: XINGSeeker::getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the media in microseconds if available.

methods.name: XINGSeeker::getOffsetForTime
methods.description: Calculates the byte offset in the file corresponding to a given playback time.

methods.name: XINGSeeker::CreateFromSource
methods.description: Static method to create a XINGSeeker instance by parsing a data source starting at a specific position.
